summary_1line: Hanuman recounts Sita’s plea for Rama to defeat Ravana openly and reassures her that Rama and the monkey army will soon come to rescue her.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sita, pale and sorrowful in the Ashoka grove, speaks earnestly to Hanuman while he kneels before her among the trees.
Hanuman stands confidently before Sita, describing the vast monkey army while the grove surrounds them in tense silence.
Sita gazes into the distance as Hanuman promises that Rama and Lakshmana will soon appear at Lanka’s gates with the roaring monkey hosts.
